## Tracking issue

<!-- Required for every PR, including documentation and maintenance.
Use "Closes #<number>" only when this PR completes the issue.
Otherwise use "Refs #<number>" and record remaining work on the issue. -->

## Purpose and scope

<!-- Explain the change, non-goals, and how it meets the issue's acceptance criteria. -->

## Validation

<!-- Record actual checks and results; distinguish missing/not-applicable checks.
Documentation-only changes need no application tests unless documentation tests exist. -->

## Product outcomes and architecture feedback

<!-- Link affected metric definitions and the issue's value hypothesis.
State direct/indirect/no metric impact and rationale.
Separate implementation check results from observed product outcomes; mark unmeasured.
Compare expected versus observed effects, including costs and guardrails.
Explain architecture alternatives, feasibility constraints, and relevant ADRs.
Record proposed/approved/rejected/deferred deviations with evidence and approval reference.
Update the scorecard/ADRs only to reflect explicitly approved decisions.
For pending outcomes, link a follow-up issue with a named owner and review date/milestone. -->

## Limitations and decisions

<!-- Include remaining work, relevant ADRs, and the engineering standard version.
Issue linkage is verified during review; no automated linkage gate is configured.
Opening this PR does not authorize merging it. -->
